text:
Mira: quick standup — ticket volume light this morning. backlog ~12, P1: 1 (webhook), P2s: 3. moving some macros now. pinging @Sam for the webhook follow-up.
Sam: on it. dug into the webhook: auth token expired on the consumer side. patch going to staging now. running smoke tests.
TicketBot: Automated: New ticket #2445 created — webhook fails for Customer X (created by inbound-email)
Luis: i'll own the macro updates — trimming steps + add token refresh troubleshooting note. will post PR shortly.
Anya: heads up — seeing slight uptick in embedding errors after last deploy (0.8% -> 2.1%). watching. if >3% we fallback to v1 embeddings model.
Sam: patch landed to staging; smoke passed 👍. deploying to canary now. will ping when canary is green.
Mira: thanks. if canary is green before 10:30 i'll run the canary sweep and update the public macro. can someone add `check-token` step in the 'webhook troubleshoot' macro? it currently doesn't mention token refresh.
Luis: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/macros/pull/812 — minor wording + add `check-token` snippet. @Mira @Sam please review.
Anya: i'll keep monitoring the embeddings dashboard for the next 30m. if errors spike we can trigger rollback. no blockers from my side.
Sam: canary is green, rolling to prod in 5. will update ticket #2445 and CC the customer comms macro.
Mira: today: finish backlog sweep, update onboarding doc for new agents, triage handoff at 14:00. no blockers aside from the webhook which looks handled. :thumbsup: 
Luis: merged macro changes and updated the macro library. pushed a small note about token expiry cadence.
TicketBot: Automated: Ticket #2445 status updated -> awaiting customer confirmation
Sam: leaving a quick note in the ticket that token expiry was root cause and we added steps to prevent.
Mira: awesome — thanks team. if anything else pops up i'll post here; otherwise afternoon shift can pick up the rest.
